messages:
maria: Heads up — noticed inconsistent token counts between edge-proxy and billing-ingest over the last 3 hours, spikes around 13:04 UTC. Anyone else seeing this?

aj: Yep, seeing a skew. Preliminary looks like routing fingerprints differ when requests hit the sha-based router fallback.

dan: Is this the case where some paths hash client_id+route and others hash client_id+region? That can easily produce different keys and double-count.

sam: Pasted a raw event we saw at ingest (redacted):
```json
{
  "client_id": "acct_abc123",
  "headers": {"user-agent": "curl/7.82", "x-routing-id": "r-fp-9f8a"},
  "tokens": 42,
  "route": "/v1/generate"
}
```

ops-bot: Alert: billing-ingest ingest-lag > 5m (3 occurrences) — investigate.

kevin: Quick grep: ~0.7% of events at ingress have `x-routing-id` missing/null. Those appear to be from the new canary router that normalizes headers.

maria: Right — the canary added header normalization middleware and by default strips unknown headers. @aj can you confirm?

aj: Confirmed. The middleware white-lists headers and drops others. I didn’t whitelist `x-routing-id` because we were trying to reduce header surface area. I can add it back, but we need to consider downstream privacy implications.

lucy: We should also harden the ingest enrichment: fallback to a computed fingerprint from ip+ua when header missing, and mark `fp_source` so we can audit. But computed fp can collide for NATted clients.

dan: Proposal: during rollout emit both `routing_fingerprint` (if header present) and `computed_fingerprint` (fallback). Add `fp_source` enum: ["header", "computed"]. That way reconciliation can align counts.

sam: I can update the enrichment lambda to attach `computed_fingerprint` and `fp_source`. Will push to staging then a small canary. Logging verbose for 24h.

kevin: Heads up: dedupe and invoice pipeline currently use `routing_fingerprint` as the canonical key. Any change to event shape needs billing sign-off — pinged finance via BL-1243.

maria: Thanks. I created ticket BL-1243 and linked sample mismatches. Also adding a dashboard tile that compares unique fingerprint counts between edge and ingest hourly.

ops-bot: Deploy queued: enrichment-canary -> prod-small at 1977770123.

sam: Deployed canary to prod-small. Verbose logs enabled. Sample enriched event: 
```json
{
  "client_id": "acct_abc123",
  "routing_fingerprint": null,
  "computed_fingerprint": "cfp-5b2e",
  "fp_source": "computed",
  "tokens": 42
}
```

aj: I'll also add an hourly reconciliation job that compares distinct fingerprints and total tokens between edge and ingest and emits an alert if skew > 0.2%. Will add a trace/span to make correlation easier.

lucy: I'll update the routing policy docs and add a short retro note — we slipped on updating the header whitelist in rollout notes.

maria: Plan of record: 1) patch router whitelist to include `x-routing-id` (aj) 2) enrichment fallback + `fp_source` (sam) 3) hourly reconciliation job + alerts (aj) 4) dashboard tile for hourly compare (maria) 5) billing ticket BL-1243 + finance review (maria). Rollout window: gradual over next 48h, monitor skew. :thumbsup:

kevin: +1

dan: If skew persists above 0.2% after both patches, escalate to oncall and open a hotfix branch.

maria: tagging folks: @aj @sam @kevin @lucy — can everyone ack when their piece is done so I can close BL-1243? :eyes:
